record.one_liner: HubSpot provides date-versioned REST APIs and bearer token/OAuth authentication for CRM and business operations data integration.

auth_methods.quote: When making a call to one of the HubSpot API endpoints, set the value of the Authorization field to Bearer [YOUR_TOKEN] ... Private app access tokens are implemented on top of OAuth

access_test.quote: Private Apps (Any Hub)Free and Starter 100 / private app 250,000 / account

access_ship.quote: Private Apps (Any Hub)Free and Starter 100 / private app 250,000 / account

api_type.quote: For example, to retrieve all contacts: GET /crm/objects/2026-09/contacts All APIs, whether legacy, new, or beta, use the same root path as before: https://api.hubapi.com/ .

api_breadth.quote: Private apps allow you to use HubSpot’s APIs to access specific data from your HubSpot account. You can authorize what each private app can request or change in your account

auth_methods.reason: Page 1 explicitly states that requests use a Bearer token in the Authorization header and that private app tokens are implemented on top of OAuth.

access_test.reason: The provided pages mention navigating to Development in a standard HubSpot account but do not state whether testing access or accounts are free.

access_ship.reason: The provided pages explain how private apps access HubSpot account data, but do not state whether production usage or shipping integrations is free.

api_type.reason: Page 2 demonstrates REST HTTP endpoints using standard HTTP methods such as GET /crm/objects/2026-09/contacts.

api_breadth.reason: The pages show APIs spanning multiple core platform areas, including CRM objects (contacts, companies), HubDB, webhooks, and CMS.
